newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China coal miner to offer 700 mln H shares in '97.
newsitem.headline: China coal miner to offer 700 mln H shares in '97.

text.p: Coal miner Anhui Xinji Energy Development Co Ltd expects to launch an initial public offering of 700 million H shares next year, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

The company, one of the 38 firms newly selected by the Chinese securities authorities as candidates for overseas listings, expects to list the shares on the Hong Kong bourse by the third quarter of 1997, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm, whose assets are being restructured, is in the process of choosing an underwriter for the offer, he said.
The company, based in the city of Huainan in eastern Anhui province, aims to use proceeds to finance the construction of a project to mine five million tonnes of coal annually, he said.
The project will be completed in four-and-a-half years after the proceeds are put to use, the official added.
The company estimates it will have net profits of 200 million yuan for 1996 against 140 million yuan a year earlier, he said.
He said the firm expects to raise its coal mining capacity to 7.50 million tonnes annually in 1997 from the present 6.60 million.
